description: Source code for the UpgradeMetaHelper class, which manages upgrade procedures, metadata parsing, file modifications, and module handling within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM ecosystem.

classes.name: UpgradeMetaHelper
classes.description: A class that provides methods for handling metadata during module upgrades, including parsing, validation, directory creation, and module management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes upgrade and customization modules, setting up directories and parsers.

methods.name: getModifiedModules
methods.description: Returns modules with files that do not match the stored MD5 checksums indicating modifications.

methods.name: saveMatchingFilesQueries
methods.description: Saves file query data related to upgrade steps into a session-based temporary file.

methods.name: getAllCustomizedModulesBeyondStudio
methods.description: Returns modules that have been customized beyond Studio, based on MD5 hash comparisons.

methods.name: getAllCustomizedModules
methods.description: Identifies modules with modified or new files compared to baseline, indicating customization.

methods.name: loadStudioModules
methods.description: Loads modules that have a 'studio.php' metadata file, indicating Studio support.

methods.name: runParser
methods.description: Instantiates and runs metadata parsers on modules needing upgrades.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses specific module files for upgrades, handling different views and metadata.

methods.name: create_upgrade_directory
methods.description: Creates directory structure for upgrade modules.

methods.name: verifyMetaData
methods.description: Verifies that metadata files contain expected 'panels' or 'searchdefs' arrays.
